## Purpose
The interface-aware augmentation N²_eff and the interfacial entrainment diffusivity K_e over-mixed smoothly stably-stratified boundary layers (e.g. GABLS) while a purely-local buoyancy discriminator can't cleanly separate Sc-top jumps from resolved narrow inversions. This PR drops both closures and the associated ᶠK_entr field, K_e enthalpy piece, sedimenting-tracer K_e diagonals, kentr diagnostic, and the interface_entr_efficiency parameter. Face K_h / K_u now feed the diffusive fluxes directly.
